gemmaNativeIntegration.unavailableHere: Pinned Python 3.14.3/macOS 26.5.2 differs from current Python 3.14.7/macOS 26.7.1.
gemmaNativeIntegration.policy: Reject incompatible environments before computation. No tolerance or identity checks were relaxed.

tools.policy: Fixture test proves task composition and repository guidance hygiene. It does not attest an installed controller or create agent-loop.config.json.
